title: National Agency Programmes and Mobility
description: na.org.mk The National Agency for European Educational Programmes and Mobility is a government institution in Skopje, North Macedonia, established in 2006 to administer EU education and mobility programs including Erasmus+, Erasmus Mundus and the European Solidarity Corps. Over 20 years it has managed more than 2,500 projects involving 50,000 plus mobile participants and administering over 200 million euro in EU grants. Its activities cover higher education, vocational training, school education, youth and sport through Erasmus+ Key Actions 1, 2 and 3. The agency partners with over 1,000 organizations including universities, schools, NGOs and companies across 33 Erasmus+ countries. It also operates Eurodesk, eTwinning and Youthpass platforms for youth information and certification. Led by a director and board appointed by the Ministry of Education, it serves as North Macedonia's official Erasmus+ national coordinator.
